# Figures 

```{r initialize, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
#knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = '..')
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
here::i_am("manuscript/figures-and-tables.qmd")

library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(knitr)
```

```{r fig-phs-plot}
#| label: fig-phs
#| out-width: "90%"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-asp: 0.618
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-cap: Kaplan-Meier survival curves of prostate cancer-free survival by centile ranges of polygenic hazard score. **(A)** Curves for the HUSK cohort and **(B)** curves for the NFCS cohort. Time of "failure" is age at any diagnosis of prostate cancer. Controls were censored at age of last observation. Error ribbons are the 95% confidence interval. Note that the y-axis is truncated to 0.25-1.0

knitr::include_graphics(here("data/results/PHS601_km_curve.pdf"))

```

```{r fig-meta-plot}
#| label: fig-meta
#| out-width: "90%"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-asp: 0.618
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-cap: Kaplan-Meier survival curves of metastatic prostate cancer-free survival by centile ranges of polygenic hazard score. **(A)** Curves for the HUSK cohort and **(B)** curves for the NFCS cohort. Time of "failure" is age at diagnosis of metastatic prostate cancer. Controls were censored at age of last observation. Error ribbons are the 95% confidence interval. Note that the y-axis is truncated to 0.80-1.0 to better visualize the stratification between PHS groups given the lower rate of metastatic PCa than any PCa.

knitr::include_graphics(here("data/results/PHS601_metastatic_km_curve.pdf"))

```

```{r fig-hoxb13-plot}
#| label: fig-hoxb13
#| out-width: "90%"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-asp: 0.618
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-cap: Kaplan-Meier survival curves of prostate cancer-free survival for the whole-genome sequenced subsample of the NFCS cohort. **(A)** HOXB13 carriers and **(B)** centile ranges of polygenic hazard score. Time of "failure" is age at any diagnosis of prostate cancer. Controls were censored at age of last observation. Error ribbons are the 95% confidence interval.

knitr::include_graphics(here("data/results/p212_PHS601_wgs_km_curve.pdf"))
```

```{r fig-strat}
#| label: fig-strat
#| out-width: "90%"
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-asp: 0.618
#| fig-align: center
#| fig-cap: Cumulative incidence rate of prostate cancer per 100,000 individuals for the general population of Norway from the Norwegian Cancer Registry. Population baseline is for prostate cancer cases in Norway, 2014-2017 as reported by Huynh-Le et al. (2020). Incidence rates are stratified by the HR for the top 20% and bottom 20% of PHSes from the PHS601 model fit to the HUSK data. **(A)** Any PCa and **(B)** metastatic PCa.

knitr::include_graphics(here("data/results/PHS601_stratified_incidence_agespecific.pdf"))
```

# Tables

```{r table-1}
#| label: tbl-1
#| tbl-cap: Hazard ratios and concordance index for the any-PCa and metastatic PCa models. HRSD is the increase in HR for a 1 standard deviation increase in PHS. HR80/20 is the HR between the top quintile and the bottom quintile of PHS. Confidence intervals are the 95% bootstrap confidence intervals from 999 iterations. "Any" = any PCa, "Meta" = metastatic PCa.

table_1 = read_tsv(here("data/results/table_1.tsv"))
kable(table_1)
```


```{r table-2, eval=FALSE}
#| label: tbl-2
#| tbl-cap: Performance of PHS and HOXB13 in the whole genome sequenced subjects. For the PHS model, HR is HR between the top 1.7% of PHSes and the median. For the HOXB13 model, the HR is the increase in risk for the 1.7% of subjects with a HOXB13 mutation relative to a non-carrier. Confidence intervals are the 95% bootstrap confidence intervals from 999 iterations.

table_2 = read_tsv(here("data/results/table_2.tsv"))
kable(table_2)

```

# Supplementary Figures

::: {#suppfig-comp}

![](../data/results/PHS601_cumulative_comparison.pdf){width=85%}

Comparison of the cumulative incidence rate for the cohort data to the data for all of Norway from the Norwegian Cancer Registry. The red line is the cumulative incidence data from the cohort data. The black line is the predicted annualized incidence rate for prostate cancer cases in Norway, 2014-2017 as reported by Huynh-Le et al. (2020) **(A,B)** HUSK cohort, **(C,D)** NFCS cohort, **(A,C)** incidence rate for any PCa, and **(B,D)** incidence rate for metastatic PCa.

:::
